facts.fact: WHO Eritrea states that it has supported the Ministry of Health to introduce and sustain a functional DHIS-2 at national level, at sub-national level and in 44% of the districts, with no numerator or denominator given, and that timeliness and completeness of reporting through DHIS2 are among the best in the African region, with no figure given.

WHO Eritrea states that the Ministry of Health's HMIS unit produces the Annual Health Service Activity Report each year from routine health and disease records, and that DHIS-2 was introduced and is sustained by the Ministry with WHO support.
WHO Eritrea states that in 2022 the DHIS 2 server was upgraded to the latest version, with new data analysis applications and WHO data quality applications.

WHO Eritrea states that in the two years before its 2022 report 50 people, including data managers and HMIS focal persons at national and sub-national level, were trained through the DHIS2 academy, with training in data analysis and data quality assessment.
